answer: Call the locked collateral the reef, the quorum cutoff the ridge, and the slashable unit saffron. Each agent posts one saffron bond for one vote; a lottery samples voters by bond weight. Two winners signing the same event differently prove a clone, and the ledger burns both bonds, so one caught duplicate wipes the attacker's pool. To cross the ridge an adversary funds N identities, paying N bonds and risking them together, while an honest voter only parks its reef. Cost scales linearly with clones and forfeiture is certain, so a fake swarm never pays.
